newsitem.title: UK: France's Superphenix fast-breeder shut down.
newsitem.headline: France's Superphenix fast-breeder shut down.

text.p: France's troubled prototype Superphenix fast-breeder nuclear reactor was shut down on Wednesday only two weeks after nuclear safety regulators agreed to allow the reactor to run at 90 percent of its 1,200-megawatt capacity.

A statement issued by plant operators NERSA on Friday said the reactor was stopped on Wednesday to replace a faulty bearing on a sodium circulation pump, nuclear industry news agency NucNet said on Friday. The work was expected to take about ten days.
